Class Section

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.Section
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Section extends Object implements Cloneable
Represents a course section with the offering it's under (crossListGroup), the number enrolled, the capacity of the section, and the CRN.
